tutorial.description: Claw: A crafting material dropped by Nightmare. Rich in high-quality calcium, it's perfect for those with weak bones.
Wolf Fur: A crafting material dropped by Corrupt Merchant. It has a rich, pleasant aroma and is a superior substitute for cat fur.
Eyes: A crafting material dropped by Big Eye. Soft and chewy, with an indescribable flavor that lingers on the palate.
Flame: A crafting material dropped by Butcher. Sweet, spicy, tingling, and melts in your mouth.
Snake Jerk: A crafting material dropped by Ghost. Packed with protein and makes an excellent base for monster coffee.
Tentacle: A crafting material dropped by Little Girl. Surprisingly delicious when fully cooked—everyone who tries it, loves it.
